goal: Make CI fail, instead of skipping, when the MCP server tests cannot run. CI sets CONTEXTOS_REQUIRE_MCP=1; with it set, tests/test_mcp_server.py imports mcp directly, so a missing package is an error. Without it (local runs) the tests still skip as before.
rollback_plan: Remove the CONTEXTOS_REQUIRE_MCP env from the Tests step in .github/workflows/ci.yml and restore the plain pytest.importorskip("mcp") line in tests/test_mcp_server.py.
approvals_required: Human asked for this on 2026-11-07 (option 3: make CI prove the MCP tests ran).
